persuasionAngle.rationale: This segment's guilt about 'taking time for herself' is the leverage point. The ad doesn't comfort her — it gives her permission to be unapologetic. The world (kids, work, obligations) can wait. This hour is non-negotiable.
persuasionAngle.psychFramework: Reactance theory — when autonomy is threatened, people double down. The ad validates the instinct to push back against the pressure to always be available.

creative.headline: The world can wait.
creative.subtitle: SARAH CHEN  ///  DISTANCE
creative.tone: Quiet defiance. Not loud, not aggressive — just unmovable. She's not angry, she's decided.
creative.visualDirection: Woman in her mid-30s running alone on an empty road at dawn. Golden-blue pre-sunrise light. Shot from slightly below to convey strength. Hair pulled back, expression focused and peaceful but intense. Slightly desaturated palette — not warm and cozy, more steel-blue.
